Map project

Source: R/method_Project.R
map_project.Rd

Create a map to display the project.

Usage

map_project(x, ...)

Arguments

x

[new_project()] object.

...

arguments passed to [mapgl::mapboxgl()].

Value

A [mapgl::mapboxgl()] object.

See also

Other mapping: get_paint_parameters(), has_mapbox_token(), mapgl_add_layer(), mapgl_add_source(), mapgl_clear_layer(), mapgl_layer_id(), mapgl_source_id(), mapgl_source_layer_id(), mapgl_source_url()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
# find file path for built-in project
path <- system.file("extdata", "antarctic-peninsula.yml", package = "apscp")

# import project
x <- read_project(path)

# preview project
print(x)

# create interactive map for project data
map <- map_project(x)

# display map
# \dontrun{
print(map)
# }
}
